description: This is a Kotlin source file defining a Compose UI screen for Android, specifically the 'ConnectTabScreen' in the OpenClaw app. It manages gateway connection settings, including setup code, manual host and port, TLS, tokens, and additional controls with expandable options, status displays, and diagnostic report features.

classes.name: ConnectInputMode
classes.description: An enum class representing the input mode for connection, either SetupCode or Manual.

methods.name: ConnectTabScreen
methods.description: Primary composable function rendering the entire connection configuration UI, managing state, user interaction, and displaying connection status, control options, and diagnostics.

methods.name: MethodChip
methods.description: A composable function rendering a button that acts as a selectable chip for choosing connection method.

methods.name: QuickFillChip
methods.description: A composable for a quick-fill button presetting host and port values.

methods.name: CommandBlock
methods.description: Displays a command-line snippet in a styled surface block.

methods.name: EndpointPreview
methods.description: Displays the resolved endpoint with dividers and styling.

methods.name: outlinedColors
methods.description: Defines color configuration for outlined text fields.
